findings.message: The added focused test never imports or inspects CommandCenter or CommandCenterArt. It only reasserts registry data and a six-asset count, so it cannot detect removal of the GLB component, a duplicate path/placement literal, lost Suspense/error fallback, or loss of React-owned station/movement rendering. This does not satisfy the acceptance requirement that focused tests protect the runtime ownership boundary.

required_fixes: Replace or extend tests/command-center-runtime.test.ts with focused assertions that exercise or inspect the CommandCenter/CommandCenterArt integration boundary: registry-backed asset and placement use, local Suspense/error fallback, and preservation of React-owned InteractionStation and MoveTargetMarker rendering.
